issue.title: Files deck never spreads: on_worker_state_changed gates on nonexistent Worker.StateChanged.is_done
issue.description:
The Files deck can never switch to spread mode in the live app. `DeckPanelFilesMixin.on_worker_state_changed` (`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/decks/panel_files.py`) returns early unless `getattr(event, "is_done", False)`, but `textual.worker.Worker.StateChanged` (Textual 8.0.1) only carries `worker` and `state`; it has no `is_done`. So the background `probe_files_spread` result is never applied: `_files_pending_probe` stays set, `_files_probe_pages` stays empty, and `_render_mode[DeckId.FILES]` stays PAGED even for two tiny markdown pages.

Root cause: gate on `event.state` (`WorkerState.SUCCESS`/`ERROR`/`CANCELLED`) instead of the nonexistent `is_done`.

Found while adding the spread-Files golden for sase-17d.10.1.4: `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_decks.py::test_agents_decks_single_files_spread_png_snapshot` has to feed the same probe result through `panel._on_files_probe_result(...)` by hand (see `_apply_files_spread_probe`). After the fix that helper can be deleted and the test can wait on `panel.is_spread(DeckId.FILES)` alone.

Caution: the fix will make small Files decks spread in every visual scenario that shows a Files deck, so expect a new round of golden updates (the linked/external repo tests pin paged mode via `pin_decks_paged` and are unaffected).

task_type_fields.impact: Every Files deck stays paged regardless of content size, so the documented spread behavior (sase-17d.8) and the spread subtitle tag never appear for Files; only tests that force the mode reach it.
task_type_fields.repro: Show the Files deck for an agent with two small file pages (zoom_multi_file_agent without its diff); after 2s panel._files_pending_probe is still set, panel._files_probe_pages is (), and panel.is_spread(DeckId.FILES) is False. Probe via PYTHONPATH=. pytest -m visual with a scratch test, or read Worker.StateChanged in textual/worker.py (no is_done attribute).

payload.entry: Being fixed as epic work: sase-17d's land agent verified this is caused by sase-17d.8 and moved it into the child epic of sase-17d (phase files-spread-probe), which closes this task when the fix lands.

Fixed in phase sase-17d.12.1 (committed by the host finalizer at the end of that phase's turn). DeckPanelFilesMixin.on_worker_state_changed now gates on Worker.StateChanged.state (WorkerState.SUCCESS reads event.worker.result; ERROR/CANCELLED clear _files_pending_probe; non-terminal states and other workers' events are ignored untouched). The probe worker also passes exit_on_error=False so a failing probe reaches the ERROR branch instead of exiting the app. _files_pending_probe is now initialised in _init_spread_state. Evidence: new tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_files_probe.py (live pilot waits on panel.is_spread(DeckId.FILES) with no hand-fed probe and sees the 'spread' subtitle tag, verified failing on the old handler; error-path pilot; unit tests for success/error/cancelled/non-terminal/other-worker/no-pending/non-probe-result). _apply_files_spread_probe was deleted and agents_decks_single_files_spread_160x40 passes unchanged 5/5 against the live probe.
